title: After an erase from another device, a value page can draw its kept pre-erase chart for under a second until its re-read lands
evidence: Done 2026-11-14 (Option B, owner-approved): RecordStore.land takes the mark first and, when the new pure Mark.erased(by:) (RecordStore+Mark.swift) sees the erase identity or the drawn eraseEpoch move, bumps erasures and catches screenErasures up in the same step. erasures' didSet drops every kept chart and running read, so the open value page's MetricRead.page has no kept chart and never draws pre-erase values while it reads again. This phone's own erases (erasePhone, showErased) bump only when land did not, so they count once. US-25 AC16j. Test: RemoteEraseTakenInTests testARemoteEraseDropsTheKeptChart_S70. Was: From the owner's review of S48 (PR 1682, adversary). ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:39: forgetCharts runs only when erasures moves, and erasures moves only for this phone's own erase. A remote erase lands a new record, so the store's revision moves but the kept histories stay. MetricRead.page (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MetricRead.swift:83) then returns .chart(kept) for an open value page until readChart (:126) lands the post-erase read, so pre-erase values can show for under a second. shownChart (RecordStore+Charts.swift:52-53) hides them only while the record predates the erase. Design note first: decide where a landed record whose erase epoch rose drops the kept charts (in land, beside forgetCharts, or by keying histories by epoch), with a test that a remote erase leaves no kept chart drawn. Verify at batch end: an open value page while the website erases. US-25 AC16f
